theorem hasDerivAt_pullback_time {h b : ℝ} {f : InnerProfile}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1 / 2) {p : PhysicalPoint} (hp : p.1 < 1)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (inner h p)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => pullback h b f (t, p.2))
      (pullback h (b - 1) (T h b f) p) p.1
